decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a core consumable with dedicated web presence, suggesting results meet aspiration and slack is sufficient to keep it.
PETG thermoforming blanks fit the firm's digital manufacturing direction and likely meet aspirations, so there is no search pressure to drop.
The UV-curing lacquer is a niche product with only a website mention, but organizational slack in a large firm allows carrying it despite uncertain demand.
Custom hearing protection earmolds align with the hearing-care channel and have survived since 2018, so slack and acceptable results support keeping them.
